name: Fox News
summary: Fox News Channel was created by Rupert Murdoch, with Roger Ailes as founding CEO, and launched on October 7, 1996. Owned by Fox Corporation, it is the most-watched U.S. cable news network and has been widely described as favoring the Republican Party.

connections.name: Tucker Carlson
connections.description: Political analyst from 2009, then host of Tucker Carlson Tonight (2016–2023).
